answer: Attester-diversity quorum: an identity's work counts only after attestations from at least 5 distinct attesters whose funding sources are 3 or more hops apart, and its weight scales with the Shannon entropy of that attester mix, full at ln(5). A farm of 100 fake keys attesting each other shows near-zero entropy, so every extra fake needs five more unrelated sponsors, and cost rises with each identity. Like a lotus rooted in many ponds, not one walnut shell of friends, a real key earns its pearl of trust from independent sources. Anyone can recompute entropy from public edges.
